explanation: The upstream provenance handoff is faulty. The criteria require preserving record identity and provenance so downstream can preserve upstream order. In job_1, assemble_provenance writes evidence_sources.record_id from source_id instead of the need record_id. Job_2 then correctly looks up ranks by coverage record_id, but the handoff contains source ids such as s01 rather than need ids such as n06-r01, so every observed upstream_rank is 0. The responsible localized fault is therefore upstream assemble_provenance, not downstream ranking logic.
cited_evidence: assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, changing record_id from need identity to source identity.
Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08 while needs contain record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id and looks up coverage.record_id; observed priorities consequently show upstream_rank: 0 for all records.
